component.name: Configuration Manager for Krita
component.summary: Easily manage and back up Krita resource profiles and configurations

description.p: Configuration Manager for Krita is an unofficial utility designed to help digital artists backup, restore, and switch between multiple Krita workspace configurations, brushes, palettes, and hotkeys.

ul.li: 1-click backup profile creation for Flatpak and native Krita installations
Instant switching between different workspace and brush setup profiles
Import and export configuration packages as .zip archives
Safe reset of Krita settings without losing personal assets

description.p: Originally created for Windows by 白熊Fx (White Bear Fx) and ported to Linux by Yiran / 毛艺然.
Initial Linux release with GTK4 and Libadwaita GNOME interface.
